column2: Retain the surrounding nations’ anger at the rebuilt altar and restored dedication. As before belongs to restoration, not a claim of a newly invented cult.
Retain the plan to remove Jacob’s descendants among them and the beginning of killing. Descendants naturally expresses the lineage noun; the violence is not reduced to mere displacement.
Retain sons of Esau, Idumea/Akrabattene, their siege of Israel and Judas’s blow, subduing and spoils. The nested regional phrase is not replaced by a modern map inference.
Retain Baean’s sons as a trap and stumbling block through road ambushes. Both images remain, with the means of danger stated.

Retain shutting the attackers in towers, siege, devotion to destruction and burning everyone inside. The inherited active recasts a passive with Judas expressly as agent without changing responsibility.
column3: The printed feminine her in the tower phrase lacks an obvious feminine antecedent; the inherited the towers omits this difficulty. What underlying referent should be represented in a fuller draft?

column2: Retain the Ammonites, strong force, numerous people and Timothy as leader. Force is contextual for a strong hand; it is not a literal anatomical claim.
Retain many battles, their being crushed before Judas and his striking them. The accumulation is not shortened to a single undocumented encounter.
Retain Jazer and its daughter towns, then return to Judea. Daughter towns preserves the dependent-settlement image.

Retain nations gathering against Israelites within their territory and the Israelites’ flight to Dathema. The English resolves the contextually clear subject change, without reversing attacker and refugee.
Retain letters addressed to Judas and his brothers, and the writers’ claim that neighbouring nations gathered to destroy them. The first-person address remains inside the letter.
Retain the intended seizure of their refuge and Timothy commanding the force. Preparations are not translated as an already completed capture.
Retain now, the plea to come/rescue from their hand and many already fallen. The hand image and causal appeal remain.

Retain the Tobiah region, all brothers killed, wives/children/belongings captured and about one thousand men destroyed. About qualifies the count, while all applies to the reported brothers in that locality.
Propose restoring behold at the arrival of the second messengers while the letters are still being read. Keep Galilee, torn garments and the relation of their report to the preceding news.
Retain Ptolemais, Tyre, Sidon and all Galilee of foreigners, and the shift from indirect them to quoted us. Do not silently make the entire sentence uniform reported speech.
Retain the great assembly deliberating aid to distressed brothers under attack. The two descriptions of their condition remain without assigning an unstated solution yet.
Retain the division of tasks: Simon to Galilee, Judas with Jonathan to Gilead. Ordinary human you/your applies even within the solemn command.
Retain Joseph son of Zechariah and Azariah with the remaining force. The singular leader phrase follows Azariah; do not force it into the plural title appearing later.
Retain guarding/taking charge of the people and the prohibition on engaging nations until their return. The time limit is essential to the later disobedience account.
Retain three thousand assigned to Simon and eight thousand to Judas, with their separate destinations. The passive assignment does not supply a named allocating official.
Retain Simon’s many battles in Galilee and the nations being crushed before him. The collective Greek agreement does not require changing the nations to one named opponent.
Retain pursuit to Ptolemais’s gate, about three thousand enemy fallen and taking their spoils. Gate is singular and the count approximate.
Retain the Galilee/Arbattos group, wives, children and all possessions moving to Judea with great gladness. This is a population movement, not only returning troops.
Retain Judas and Jonathan crossing the Jordan and a three-day wilderness journey. Do not equate the duration with a modern reconstructed mileage.
Retain the peaceful Nabatean encounter and their report about the brothers in Gilead. The English who received resolves the source’s contextual speaker shift provisionally.
Retain the difficult Bosora, Bosor in Alema, Chaspho, Maked and Carnaim sequence without normalizing it to another list. All these cities being strong and large remains.
column3: How does in Alema attach to the preceding Bosor, and does the selected list distinguish Alema as another city? Place-name collation remains open.

column2: Retain people confined in other Gilead cities and the next-day plan to seize strongholds and destroy them in one day. The enemy is a supplied contextual subject, not an additional named force.

Retain the sudden route change toward Bosora, seizure, killing every male, all spoils and burning. The difficult wilderness/route attachment is provisional; the violence is not softened to combatants alone.
column3: Does the directional phrase attach wilderness to the route or to Bosora? No geographical reconstruction is treated as decisive.

column2: Retain singular departure and plural travel by night to the stronghold. Context permits Judas and his army without adding an independently named destination here.

Propose restoring behold and using a great multitude beyond counting for the large unnumbered people. Preserve raised eyes, ladders, engines, seizure purpose and attack on the defenders; the supplied there was unfolds the Greek nominal presentation.
Retain Judas seeing battle begun and the city’s cry rising to heaven with trumpets and loud shouting. The source’s audible imagery remains rather than being reduced to a tactical report.
Retain fight today for our brothers, including the selected first-person possessive. Do not harmonize it to your brothers from a different reading or familiar translation.
Retain the rear approach in three divisions, trumpet blasts and prayerful cry. The three command groupings are not converted into a troop count.
Retain recognition of Maccabeus, flight, a great blow and about eight thousand fallen that day. The approximate total is left intact even beside other campaign counts.
Retain Alema’s attack, seizure, killing every male, spoils and burning. Every male is not narrowed to armed men without support.
Retain Chaspho, Maked, Bosor and other Gilead cities in this sequence. No attempt is made to resolve the earlier location syntax by altering this list.
Retain another army under Timothy and the camp opposite Raphon across the stream. After these events is a natural event sense for the source’s words/things expression.
Retain Judas sending scouts and their report of all surrounding nations gathering to Timothy. Men is supplied as the natural object of sending to reconnoitre, not a stated number.
Retain hired Arabs, readiness across the stream and Judas’s response. You is ordinary singular human address within the scouts’ report.
Retain Timothy’s conditional warning that Judas crossing first would prevent resistance. Surely prevail naturally carries the repeated ability construction; no divine prediction is introduced.
Retain the alternative if Judas fears and camps beyond the river, followed by Timothy’s planned crossing and victory. River differs from the surrounding stream term and is not harmonized away.

Retain the watercourse, stationed officers and prohibition on anyone encamping, with everyone entering battle. Officers is contextual for scribes/administrative personnel and remains a military-role interpretation.
column3: Should scribes remain audible here instead of officers? The function is clear from the order, but the exact title requires lexical review.

column2: Retain Judas crossing first, all people following, all nations routed, weapons discarded and refuge at Carnaim’s sacred precinct. The precinct is not silently replaced with the Jerusalem sanctuary.
Retain seizure, burning the precinct with everyone inside and Carnaim’s rout. The collective inability to resist Judas remains without minimizing the people burned.
Retain all Israel in Gilead from small to great, families and belongings, a great company moving to Judah. Company contextualizes army/camp for the civilian-inclusive body.
Retain Ephron’s size and strength, no right/left detour and the necessity of passing through. This reports the narrative’s route constraint without claiming a modern topographical verification.
Retain city inhabitants excluding the company and blocking gates with stones. Both deliberate defensive acts remain.

Retain the peaceful proposal, their land/our land, promise of no harm and passage on foot, followed by refusal. Greek singular city-address shifts to plural people-address; English your/you remains number-neutral.
Retain proclamation that each encamp where he is. The distributive each must not become a general permission to select a new position.
Retain the troops encamping, Judas’s attack throughout day and night, and the city given into his hand. The passive does not expressly identify God as deliverer.
Retain destruction of every male, uprooting, spoils and passing over the slain. Both the violent action and bodily aftermath remain without euphemism.
Retain crossing the Jordan into the great plain opposite Beth-shan. The inherited place form is provisional, with no modern geographical gloss added.
Retain gathering laggards and encouragement along the whole route until Judah. The continuing verbs are not recast as a single isolated speech.
Retain joyful ascent, whole burnt offerings and the claim none had fallen before peaceful return. The scope concerns this returning group and is not used to erase casualties elsewhere in the chapter.
Retain the simultaneous locations of Judas/Jonathan in Gilead and Simon in Galilee opposite Ptolemais. The temporal opening must continue into Joseph and Azariah’s actions.
Retain Joseph son of Zechariah and Azariah as commanders hearing of bravery and warfare. The plural role here does not require retroactively changing the singular apposition in verse 18.
Retain their resolve to make a name for themselves and fight surrounding nations. The self-seeking motive is spoken by them and remains distinct from Judas’s earlier instructions.

Propose He gave orders in place of They gave orders, preserving the selected singular command verb followed by plural movement to Jamnia. He is a contextual English pronoun for an unnamed commander, not gender encoded by the Greek verb.
column3: Which commander is the unexpressed singular subject? The proposed wording preserves the source shift without choosing Joseph or Azariah by name.

column2: Retain Gorgias and his men leaving the city to meet them in battle. The narrative now names the opposing commander explicitly.
Retain Joseph/Azariah’s rout, pursuit to Judea’s borders and about two thousand Israelite deaths. The selected name-form variation does not establish a different Joseph.
Retain the great rout caused by not obeying Judas and brothers while expecting brave deeds. The narrator’s causal judgment remains visible rather than being softened into mere unfortunate timing.
Retain line/seed, the contrasted men and deliverance granted through their hand. The inherited formulation is provisional and must not be expanded into a doctrine of inherited office.
column3: How does to whom deliverance was given relate to through their hand, and how literal is the lineage contrast? Full syntactic and historical interpretation remains open.

column2: Retain The man Judas, brothers, all Israel and all nations wherever their name was heard. The explicit man is not silently omitted as stylistic redundancy.
Retain gathering and acclaiming them, with people supplied for an unexpressed plural subject. No exact constituency or count is inserted.
Retain sons of Esau, the south, Hebron/daughter towns, demolished fortifications and burned towers. The shift from plural campaign to singular Judas’s striking follows the selected narrative.
Retain travel toward foreign territory through Marisa. The place is not substituted with a better-known similar name without textual evidence.
Retain priests falling through their desire for brave deeds and going out without counsel. The criticism of their conduct is explicit and should not be excused by an invented command.
Retain Azotus, pagan altars, carved images of their gods, fire, spoils and return to Judah. Pagan marks the contextual altar distinction without inserting a deity’s name.
